# vvcanvas

[![CodeFactor](https://www.codefactor.io/repository/github/vusaverse/vvcanvas/badge)](https://www.codefactor.io/repository/github/vusaverse/vvcanvas)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/vusaverse/vvcanvas/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/vusaverse/vvcanvas/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![CRAN
status](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/vvcanvas)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=vvcanvas/)
[![The diffify page for the R package
vvcanvas](https://diffify.com/diffify-badge.svg)](https://diffify.com/R/vvcanvas)
[![CRAN last month
downloads](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/last-month/vvcanvas?color=green/)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=vvcanvas/)
[![CRAN last month
downloads](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/vvcanvas?color=green/)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=vvcanvas/)

The open source R package vvcanvas provides a convenient interface to
interact with the Canvas Learning Management System (LMS) API. It allows
users to authenticate, retrieve course information, fetch specific
details, and perform various operations within the Canvas LMS.

## Installation

You can install the `vvcanvas` package from GitHub using the following
command:

    devtools::install_github("vusaverse/vvcanvas")

It is also possible to install from CRAN:

    install.packages("vvcanvas")

## Features

To see which functions are available in which section based on the
CANVAS LMS API structure, please refer to the reference page of the
`vvcanvas` package. The
[reference](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/index.html)
page provides a comprehensive list of functions available in the
package, organized by category.

Additionally, the package includes vignettes that provide more detailed
information on how to use the functions in the package.

## Getting Started

To begin using the `vvcanvas` package, you need to authenticate with the
Canvas LMS API by obtaining an API key and base URL. Follow these steps
to get started:

1.  Acquire an API key from your Canvas LMS instance. You may need to
    consult your Canvas administrator or refer to the Canvas API
    documentation for instructions on obtaining an API key.

2.  Once you have the API key, load the `vvcanvas` library and use the
    `canvas_authenticate` function to authenticate with the Canvas LMS
    API. Provide the API key and the base URL of your Canvas instance as
    parameters. Here’s an example:

``` r
library(vvcanvas)

# Replace the placeholders with your API key and base URL
api_key <- "YOUR_API_KEY"
base_url <- "https://your_canvas_domain.com/"

# Authenticate with the Canvas LMS API
canvas <- canvas_authenticate(api_key, base_url)

## Alternatively, you can set system variables

# Set the API key and base URL as environment variables
Sys.setenv(CANVAS_API_KEY = "YOUR_API_KEY")
Sys.setenv(CANVAS_BASE_URL = "https://your_canvas_domain.com/")

# Authenticate with the Canvas LMS API
canvas <- canvas_authenticate()
```

With the authentication step completed, you can now utilize the various
functions provided by the `vvcanvas` package to interact with the Canvas
LMS.

In order to retrieve a dataframe with all courses you can use the
following function:

``` r
# Pass the canvas object to the get_courses function
courses <- get_courses(canvas)
```

# Package index

## Other methods.

Methods that need to be indexed.

- [`create_course_datalake()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/create_course_datalake.md)
  : Create a data lake for a course.
- [`canvas_authenticate()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/canvas_authenticate.md)
  : Authenticate with Canvas LMS API
- [`get_page_content()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_page_content.md)
  : Retrieves the content body of a specified page.
- [`download_course_file()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/download_course_file.md)
  : Downloads a file from a given URL.
- [`canvas_api_key()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/canvas_api_key.md)
  : Get the Canvas API key from the environment variable
- [`canvas_base_url()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/canvas_base_url.md)
  : Get the Canvas base URL from the environment variable

## Accounts

Methods for accounts.

- [`get_accounts()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_accounts.md)
  : Get a list of accounts from the Canvas LMS API
- [`get_users()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_users.md)
  : Get all users from an account
- [`list_all_enrollment_terms()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/list_all_enrollment_terms.md)
  : List All Enrollment Terms

## Analytics

Methods for analytics.

- [`get_department_participation_data()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_department_participation_data.md)
  : Get department-level participation data from the Canvas LMS API
- [`get_department_grade_data()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_department_grade_data.md)
  : Get department-level grade data from the Canvas LMS API
- [`get_department_statistics()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_department_statistics.md)
  : Get department-level statistics from the Canvas LMS API
- [`get_department_statistics_by_subaccount()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_department_statistics_by_subaccount.md)
  : Get department-level statistics by subaccount from the Canvas LMS
  API
- [`get_course_participation()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_course_participation.md)
  : Get course-level participation data from Canvas LMS API
- [`get_student_summaries()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_student_summaries.md)
  : Get student summaries for a course from Canvas LMS API
- [`get_user_course_participation_data()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_user_course_participation_data.md)
  : Get user-in-a-course-level participation data from the Canvas LMS
  API
- [`get_user_course_assignment_data()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_user_course_assignment_data.md)
  : Get user-in-a-course-level assignment data from the Canvas LMS API
- [`get_user_course_messaging_data()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_user_course_messaging_data.md)
  : Get user-in-a-course-level messaging data from the Canvas LMS API
